newsitem.title: USA: U.S. junk bond funds get $374 mln in net new cash.
newsitem.headline: U.S. junk bond funds get $374 mln in net new cash.

text.p: U.S. junk bond mutual funds received $374 million in net cash inflows in the week ended June 4, according to AMG Data Services, an Arcata, Calif.-based mutual fund information company.
This week's inflows cap the net cash outflows of $31.6 million from the previous week ended May 28.

The figure of $374 million was compiled from high-yield bond mutual funds that report on a weekly basis. The figure also excludes reinvested distributions, therefore representing only new money coming into the funds.
